findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_domain · Private data: audit_domain, validate_spf_include · Public sink: audit_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_domain · Private data: audit_domain, validate_spf_include · Public sink: audit_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
